mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for kitchen cabinet and countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for kitchen cabinet and countertop installation varies based on project complexity, material availability, and cabinet type. Generally, a full kitchen installation can take anywhere from 3 to 8 weeks. This includes design, ordering materials, demolition, and the actual installation. Custom cabinets typically require a longer lead time than semi-custom or stock options. Countertop fabrication and installation usually follow cabinet installation and can add several days to a week to the process. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial design and material selection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen cabinet and countertop installation typically takes 3 to 8 weeks, depending on project complexity and material lead times.
